# Vendored browser code

Kanvas serves these files itself at `/api/vendor/<name>`, so the page loads nothing from the network.

| File | Package | Source |
|------|---------|--------|
| `xterm/xterm.js`, `xterm/xterm.css`, `xterm/LICENSE` | `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0 (MIT) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@xterm/xterm@5.5.0/` |
| `xterm/addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0 (MIT) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@xterm/addon-fit@0.10.0/` |

To update, download the same paths at the new version and change the table.
